candidate_workaround: Allow 120 seconds for the owner and delta Git-blob manifest rebuild, then verify coverage and hashes from the emitted receipts.
failure_signature: A targeted final-manifest rebuild exceeded a 30-second command wrapper and was terminated before returning a completion receipt.
recurrence_guard: Use the measured manifest-rebuild envelope rather than the generic short wrapper, and grant credit only after exact coverage and hash parity pass.
rollback: Retain the timed-out attempt with zero manifest credit, inspect partial outputs, and overwrite only generated manifest receipts during one bounded recovery.
scope_boundary: Same-owner generated-manifest recovery only; no scientific, professional, legal, cultural, Maori-authority, production, security, accessibility, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Budget final Git-blob manifest rebuilds to the measured envelope
trigger_preconditions: A source-to-final manifest rebuild hashes hundreds of Git-filtered blobs in the Windows owner lane.
